_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: germanic (norse) backbone + north_american (woodland) overlay (cross-family blend, balanced but Germanic-named)

blend.backbone: germanic (norse: the longship-folk; nominative -r, w- lost before round vowels (Wod->Od-), ai>ei, i/u-umlaut, -son/-dottir, the konungr/jarl/godi register, the dithematic Thor-/Gunn-/-ulfr name-stock)
blend.overlay: north_american (woodland: Iroquoian/Haudenosaunee register, labial-free, the longhouse-clans (kanonhsa / ohwachira), the kanata-towns, the royaner/hoyaneh sachem ranks and the clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner), the forest substrate (karhakonha) and the totemic clan-powers)
blend.lean: balanced but Germanic-named - a Norse settler-aristocracy planted in Vinland and woven into the Woodland longhouse-clans: the longship-folk and the People of the land, both kindred-bound, fused into one frontier folk. The Norse martial/naming layer is the surface; the Woodland clan-and-forest substrate is the deep weave. Two kindreds, one kinhold.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_01 Thiodmark (Germanic) x BASE_11 (North American Woodland; the Oronan base-stock). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: both parent bases are Clanhold (Germanic Thiodmark = Clanhold; Woodland = Clanhold), and Clan+Clan -> Clan, so Maniheim is a Clanhold culture: a Norse kindred-kingship (the konungr and his sworn hird) entwined with the matrilineal longhouse-clans of the Woodland, NOT a centralized feudal state - kindred-and-comitatus bound, modeled on Brythald's (HYB_01) clanhold treatment. Concept: 'Maniheim' (a Vinland frontier-folk) - Norse Vinland settlers among the Woodland peoples, longship-folk and the People of the land fused. Backbone = Germanic (norse: the ruling settler-stock, the konungr/jarl/godi register, dithematic names); overlay/substrate = Woodland (the longhouse-clans, the kanata-towns, the royaner/hoyaneh ranks rendered in the kit's labial-free register, the forest and the clan-totems). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Old Norse and Woodland/Iroquoian registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Norse reflexes from family_germanic.json theonym_ancestors PRIMARY, Woodland morphs from family_north_american.json theonym_sets.woodland SECONDARY), never real Norse gods or real Indigenous powers. PROVISIONAL: alignment ([Neutral]) is a per-hybrid design choice pending the alignment pass - a settled frontier kindred whose Norse ancestor-cult and Woodland clan-and-forest spirits both read Neutral (the great powers invoked situationally, not worshipped wholesale); flag for Jedidiah if a Lawful reading (a sworn frontier league under the One) is wanted. Dual register: Norse names for the settler-stock, Woodland names for the People. [UPDATE 2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are now English (or an approved foreign term); conlang titles moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Deities unchanged: canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Old Norse backbone - heavy root-initial stress, sharp stops p/t/k b/d/g, retained th/dh, nominative -r, w- lost before round vowels (Wod->Od-), ai>ei, i- and u-umlaut, dithematic compounding, -son/-dottir patronymics - meeting a Woodland (Iroquoian) overlay that LACKS labials (no p/b/m/f): consonants t k s h n r w y, ts, kw, hr, glottal stop '; vowels a e i o u with nasalization (en/on); long polysynthetic compounds. Per the CSV: ejective consonants and sharp stops; grammar shifts toward SOV, polysynthetic with strong verbs (the Woodland substrate's long incorporating compounds carried on Norse strong/ablaut stems). Theophoric on the Norse reflexes (Thulrs-, Orlund-) with labial-free Woodland variants (Tularonon-, Oranhonon-).
phonology.phonotactics: Norse CVC and clusters (st, sk, br, kn, hl, hr) with nominative -r and root-initial stress, meeting Woodland CV(C) labial-free polysynthetic compounds, glottal stops and nasal vowels; dithematic Norse names over kanata-/karhakon- substrate toponyms; the Norse -heim/-by sits beside the Woodland kanata-.

sound_changes: Woodland polysynthetic compounds clipped to a Norse-stress root: drop the noun-prefix ka-/o-/on- and the trailing incorporated material, keep one stressed CVC core (kahyonha>hjon-, karhakonha>karhak-, kaniatare>njatr-)
Woodland labial-free inventory adapts cleanly into Norse (no p/b/m/f to convert); the glottal stop ' drops or hardens to t, and nasal vowels (en/on) flatten to plain a/e/o

Norse nominative -r and permitted clusters (st, sk, hr, kw, tr) close the clipped roots: short Woodland cores take a Norse -r/-s ending (onyara>njarr, owera>werr); ts/kw are kept as Norse-legal clusters
Norse root-initial stress imposed on every word, from either parent; retained Norse th/dh, ei, au and the -son/-dottir morphemes survive intact on the surface
fusion_rules.source_tilt: forest/land/terrain/material/staple words from Woodland roots (the People work the land - njatr lake, karhakr forest, kanatr town, nenhstr maize); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Norse roots (the settler register - mikilr great, svartr black, jarn iron, hross horse); every root then clipped and -r-closed to one Norse-shaped phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Woodland forest/land/staple-roots + Norse kin/quality/rule-roots, all clipped to one Norse-shaped sound-law (root-initial stress, nominative -r, labial-free cores); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline (ronson, kanhus, kanvirki, kanonhof).

morphology.patronymic_form: the Norse settler-stock keep the dithematic name + -son / -dottir patronymic (and an aett lineage-name for the chief houses); the Woodland People keep the ohwachira (matrilineal clan, by animal-totem) and the clan-held name bestowed by the clan-mother (Iakoia:ner); the kinhold fuses both - a konungr who is also seated by the clan-mothers of the longhouse he was wedded into.
morphology.compounding_rule: Norse dithematic ([quality|animal](stem) + element: Jarn-haugr, iron-hill; Svart-skogr, black-forest) layered over Woodland long compounds ([quality|feature] + place: Onekwenhtara-karhakonha, red-forest): the chief seat Vinheim (the vine-home), Kanata-by (the longhouse-town beside the Norse steading).

title_ladder.government: clanhold (a Norse kindred-kingship entwined with the Woodland longhouse-clans: the konungr and his jarls at the crown, the hersar over the kindreds, the karls sworn to the hird; the thing counsels and the clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner) seat and unseat the chiefs, the Woodland sachem-council (royaner) endures beneath - kindred-and-comitatus bound, NOT a centralized feudal state)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Norse clanhold ladder, ascending, with the Woodland sachem co-titles beneath. Hersir (local kindred-chieftain, war-leader of a district) barony over a Hersirdaemi; Mark-vordr (march-warden) march over a Mork; Jarl (earl, the great kindred-lord) county over a Jarldom; Stor-jarl (great earl, over-jarl) duchy; Fylkir (leader of a folk-host, a confederation of kindreds) principality over a Fylki; Konungr (king, raised by the thing and the kindreds) kingdom over a Konungriki; Yfir-konungr (over-king, high-king of all the kindreds) empire over the Stor-riki (the great realm). This is a kindred-king (raised and judged by the thing, not an absolute feudal monarch), NOT a feudal lord. The Woodland substrate keeps its own council beneath: the royaner / hoyaneh (sachems), the rotiskenrakehte (war-leaders), seated and deposed by the clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner). The godi (Norse priest-chief) and the rotihontsa (Woodland faithkeeper) stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Old Norse and Woodland registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Konungs-barn (the king's child, the throne-worthy heir; among the Woodland kindred a chief's seat is conferred within the clan by the Iakoia:ner, not inherited father-to-son)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Norse settler-stock carry a dithematic given name + -son / -dottir patronymic (and an aett lineage-name for the chief houses); the Woodland People carry a clan-held name + the ohwachira (matrilineal clan, by animal-totem) bestowed by the clan-mother; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Norse settler-aristocracy keep dithematic names (Thor-, Gunn-, Stein-, -ulfr, -arr, -gerdr); the Woodland People keep clan-held names (the labial-free Tehan-, Karon-, Skana- stems) bestowed and recalled by the clan-mother.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Norse devotional names on the morphed canon-reflexes (Thulrs-, Orlund-, Geyandr-): Thorulfs becomes Thulrs-ulfr (the wolf of Thulr), Orlund-arr (the warrior of Orlund); the Woodland substrate invokes the powers by domain rather than by name, favoring the clan-totem animals and the forest.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Norse reflexes PRIMARY (from family_germanic.json theonym_ancestors, the norse column), Woodland variants SECONDARY (from family_north_american.json theonym_sets.woodland; labial-free, matching real Iroquoian), never real Norse gods or real Indigenous powers. Shared pantheon, two registers. Alignment PROVISIONAL ([Neutral]): a settled frontier kindred - the Norse ancestor-cult (the deified aett-dead) and the Woodland clan-and-forest spirits both read Neutral; the great powers are invoked situationally at the hof-grove and the rite-longhouse rather than worshipped wholesale.
religion.the_one: Eitnir (Norse; Woodland Aterhonon) - the distant Ancient One, the Sky-Holder-Above, acknowledged but set aside, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Thulr (Woodland Tularonon) - the sun, the day-keeper, justice
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Geyandr (Woodland Kayanonon) - the enduring earth, the earth-holder
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Rjalta (Woodland Realwenne) - the mother, mercy, the clan-mother of the powers

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: Venerates the Lawful powers of the canon - Eitnir foremost - and names the Chaotic powers as demons to be warded.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the ancestral dead (the deified aett-dead of the settler-houses, kept at the howe) and the Woodland clan- and forest-spirits (the karhakonha-powers and the clan-totems), with the thanksgivings to the growing things; the great powers invoked situationally at the hof-grove and the rite-longhouse rather than worshipped wholesale
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eitnir - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, when warded, keep their morphs + a dread epithet: Maraxus -> Marhr the War-Brand (Woodland Waraksonon the War-Fire); Vacidus -> Vakr the Unmaker (Woodland Wasidonon the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusandr the Hoard-Worm (Woodland Rusanonon the Greed-Serpent).

clergy_ladder.9: Allsherjar-godi (the supreme priest of the realm) / Kanonhsiyonni-tha (the council's high keeper)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Hof (Norse temple) or Lundr (sacred grove) of [power] beside the Woodland Kanonhses (rite-longhouse) and the forest-grove: 'the Hof of Thulr', 'the Kanonhses of Tularonon', 'the Lundr of Geyandr'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified aett-dead (the war-honored ancestors of the settler-houses, kept at the howe) and the founders of the kindred-peace and the honored clan-mothers and sachems, kept in the thing's recital and the council's recital; honored at the howe, the hof-grove and the burial-grove.

holy_symbol_motifs.Thulr: a sun-wheel over the longship's prow
holy_symbol_motifs.Geyandr: a great oak rooted deep in the earth above the longhouse
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlund: an iron sword crossed with a war-club

banks_patterns.ships: the longship and the forest river-craft, named in Norse kennings and Woodland totems: 'the Wave-Stallion', 'Raven of the Skogr', 'the Swift Heron', 'Forest-Shadow'
banks_patterns.military_units: the konungr's hird (sworn war-troop / comitatus) and the [clan-totem] war-parties: 'the Hird of Vinheim', 'the Wolf-clan warriors', 'the Iron-helms', 'the Hawk war-party'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]' and the longhouse: 'The Red Antler', 'The Boar and Oar', 'the Turtle Longhouse'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen Norse virki and howes and abandoned palisade-kanata: 'the Howe of the [aett]', 'the broken Virki of [name]', 'the empty Kanata of [clan]', 'the Ghost-Longhouse'
